policy_notes: Editorial genre-family hierarchy. Every parent edge and alias below is explicit and reviewable.
Existing MusicBrainz pilot IDs, display names and parents remain stable. The legacy experimental ID means experimental hip-hop; Experimental alone maps to experimental-music.
No substring, fuzzy-title, descriptor or popularity inference. Unknown labels remain unmapped.
Primary and secondary labels/IDs remain separate. Trap alone requires independent hip-hop context; explicit Trap [EDM] maps only to electronic.
Crossovers use multiple parents where explicitly chosen. Broad parent membership is not a claim that all influence implies genre membership.
